<h1>Animals</h1>
<p class="sg-lede">Animal woodcuts, linocuts and engravings, cut out of their paper. Each comes in black and the three illustration inks, as a traced SVG and a transparent 1000px PNG; the snake and the butterflies also in their original colours, PNG only.</p>
<dl class="sg-facts"><dt>Use for</dt><dd>A creature to carry a story: social posts, podcast and magazine pages, section openers.</dd><dt>Colour</dt><dd>Black or one of the three illustration inks; a few also in their original colours.
